note: Fixed relation vocabulary for LeanBio statements. The 'indra' family copies INDRA statement types (https://indra.readthedocs.io/en/latest/modules/statements.html) for molecular claims; the 'law' family is ours, for the quantitative and structural claims that biology-law sources make and that INDRA has no type for. Typing is rule-based (regex triggers below, first match wins, molecular rules only fire when both sides are grounded to a gene, protein or chemical). It is a heuristic with unmeasured precision: every typed statement records the rule that fired so a reviewer can overrule it.

formalizable.theorem: a mathematical reading exists that Lean can state as a theorem over named-hypothesis structures (quantities with units)
formalizable.named-hypothesis: Lean can only carry the claim as a named empirical premise; there is nothing to prove until it is combined with other laws
formalizable.no: not a candidate for a Lean statement (meta-records, absences, assessments)
